ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Recursive Takeown
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries can interact with the DACLs using built-in Windows commands takeown which can grant adversaries higher permissions on specific files and folders

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\takeown\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/f\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/r.*")))
